office_does: The prosecuting attorney prosecutes criminal and civil cases for the state and county and is legal adviser to county officers and school directors.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Robert W. Sealby (Prefers Republican Party), appointed in 2021 and elected unopposed in 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Chelan County Prosecuting Attorney since his 2021 appointment, elected unopposed in 2022; a Wenatchee attorney licensed since 1991. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed in 2021 to replace retiring prosecutor Doug Shae; elected in 2022 [S1][S4]
In 2023 found police use of force legally justified in two fatal 2022 Wenatchee police shootings and filed no charges [S6][S7]
Former U.S. Army; past president of the Wenatchee School Board [S1]
